name: Nexans 33 kV single-core 630 mm2 XLPE cable (BS 7870-4.10, 19/33 kV)

specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 product page: 'Rated voltage 19/33kV'; 'International Standards: IEC 60502-2; National Standards: BS 7870-4.10'.
Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV BS7870 product page technical specification table: 'Nominal cross-sectional area sqmm 630' for both copper and aluminium conductor versions.

specifications.metric: 1 second short-circuit rating of conductor (copper), 90 to 250 deg C
specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: '1 Second Short Circuit Rating of Conductor (90 to 250°C) kA' copper 90.7; aluminium 60.2.

specifications.metric: 1 second short-circuit rating of 35 sqmm copper wire screen, 80 to 250 deg C
specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: '1 Second Short Circuit Rating of a 35sqmm Copper wire screen (80 to 250°C) kA 4.8' (both conductor versions).

specifications.metric: current carrying capacity, copper, laid in trefoil, in air
specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: 'Current Carrying Capacity (cables laid in trefoil) In Air A' copper 1160, aluminium 940. Ampacity basis printed on page: depth of cover 800 mm, soil thermal resistivity 1.2 K.m/W, soil temperature 15 deg C, ambient air 25 deg C, max conductor temperature 90 deg C.

specifications.metric: current carrying capacity, copper, laid in trefoil, direct buried
specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: 'Direct Buried A' copper 850, aluminium 690; single way ducts copper 780, aluminium 650; same ampacity conditions as stated on page.

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the Alaska GEG WBS sweep.
